decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family with unresolved prospects costs little to keep within an established catalogue, so the option is still worth holding.
The mitred handle line is only one year old and shares existing manufacturing and finishing, so its option value exceeds the low carrying cost while demand uncertainty persists.
The multifunctional lever fits the firm's barrier-free and hygiene strategy, and with no negative signals yet it remains a cheap option worth keeping.
Too little time has passed to resolve uncertainty about this handle line, and its incremental cost in a modular range is small.
The 2023 German Design Award and its own dedicated page signal a positively resolving option that justifies further commitment rather than withdrawal.
A finish option applies across existing handle families at minimal carrying cost, so keeping it while architect demand reveals itself is rational.
